answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in fable and ferrous recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 6 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the zenith. A 386 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
